name: graphrag-code
description: Ask about and edit a codebase in any language through its code graph (tree-sitter for Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, VS Code's language servers for the rest): local push PPR, a coverage check and a verified edit loop, with a local model.

commands.title: Show What Depends on This Symbol

graphragCode.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python 3.10+ that runs the sidecar. Left at `python`, the environment `npm run setup-python` makes (`sidecar/.venv`, with tree-sitter and LanceDB) is used when it exists. Without those packages the sidecar still runs: Python only (ast) and vectors in SQLite.

graphragCode.parser.markdownDescription: `auto`: tree-sitter (Python, TypeScript, TSX, JavaScript/JSX) when installed, else Python's `ast`. `ast`: Python only, with the standard library.

graphragCode.languageServers.markdownDescription: Use VS Code's language servers as a graph source: symbols of files no parser reads (any language with a language server extension installed), their callers, callees and type hierarchy fetched as searches reach them, and exact callers that settle the parser's guesses before an edit.

graphragCode.exploreSteps.markdownDescription: When a question's context has a gap (it names nothing the search could anchor on, or a symbol it's about didn't fit), the model may take this many steps with graph tools (`find`, `callers`, `callees`, `read`) before answering. Each step is one model call. `0`: never; every question is answered from one search.

graphragCode.vectorStore.markdownDescription: Where symbol embeddings are kept and searched. `auto`/`lancedb`: LanceDB (an embedded vector database) when installed, else SQLite. `sqlite`: the index's SQLite file, searched in memory.

graphragCode.llm.model.description: Model for answers and edits. Larger models make much better multi-file edits.

graphragCode.llm.apiKey.description: API key for the endpoint, if it needs one (Ollama doesn't).

graphragCode.embeddingModel.markdownDescription: `auto`: a code-search sentence-transformers model when `sentence-transformers` is installed (downloaded on first use), else identifier hashing. `hashing`: no model. Or any sentence-transformers model name.

graphragCode.verify.testCommand.markdownDescription: Run after each applied edit, from the workspace folder (for example `python -m pytest -x -q`). A failure goes back to the model with the output. Empty: only the language server's errors are checked.

graphragCode.verify.maxAttempts.description: Proposals per edit request, counting the first: each failed verification asks the model to fix what it found.

graphragCode.verify.diagnosticsTimeoutSe.description: How long to wait for the language server to report errors after an edit.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run bundle-core
scripts.test: npm run compile && node scripts/test-sidecar.js && node scripts/smoke.js && node scripts/lsp-test.js && node scripts/checkpoint-test.js
